fields.htc_w_k: heat transfer coefficient W/K, central h = 0.86 gas-heated homes per meter
fields.htc_mult: per town and variant (central/low/high/per_meter): HTC multiplier vs htc_w_k
fields.c_kwh_k: effective heat capacity kWh/K (SAP medium 250 kJ/m2K x floor area)
fields.heat_kwh_yr: annual SPACE heat, useful kWh, at 1991-2020 mean weather (excludes hot water)
fields.gas_factor: per town: metered space heat / EPC (Canet) or NEED-NE (Scotland) mean space heat

thermal_mass: C uses SAP 'medium' 250 kJ/m2K for every form (RdSAP default). SAP 2012 v9.92 Table 1f indicative TMP: low 100, medium 250, high 450 kJ/m2K; SAP 10.2 Table 1e lists k per construction and 1f defines TMP = sum(k A)/TFA. Low/high scale c_kwh_k by 0.4 / 1.8.
method:
Model v3 housing stock: an empirical dwelling distribution per town (79 towns), calibrated to metered gas.

Method (docs/article/lit/methods_v3.md section 3; plan "Model v3" item 3):
  1. Canet et al. (UKERC EDC, doi:10.5286/ukerc.edc.000944, CC-BY 4.0, latest = version 2 of 14 Oct 2021):
     per 2011 LSOA, number of gas-boiler dwellings and their mean EPC space-heating demand for 4 forms
     (detached, semi, terraced, flat). EPC HEATING_COST_CURRENT -> kWh, i.e. SPACE heat only, at SAP
     standard occupancy and climate. The file has NO floor area.
  2. LSOAs whose ONS 2011 population-weighted centroid is within R of the town (R = 10 km, widened in 2 km
     steps until >= 5,000 dwellings of all heating types).
  3. HTC = space heat / degree-hours (base 15.5 C, ERA5 1991-2020 hourly from history.npz).
  4. Halloran-style calibration: one factor per town so that mean modelled gas per gas dwelling
     (space heat / 0.89 + hot water / 0.89) equals DESNZ 2024 mean domestic gas per GAS-HEATED HOME
     (= mean per meter / h, h = 0.86 heated homes per meter, 0.813 / 0.913 / 1.0 as sensitivities) over the
     MSOAs (2021 PWC) inside the same R. The factor bundles EPC over-prediction AND the SAP-climate vs
     local-climate difference, because EPC demand is not at local weather.
  5. Floor area and within-cell spread from NEED anonymised 2026 (50k, OGL): for gas-heated homes of the
     same form and ONS region, the floor-area band mix, and each band's mean space-heat gas relative to the
     form x region mean (mean-preserving). So HTC and floor area co-vary as they do in metered homes.
  6. Scotland (regions N, P): no Canet. Form mix, floor area and band ratios from NEED North East
     (E12000001) gas homes, scaled to the Scottish Intermediate Zone metered gas in R. Flagged as proxy.
  7. C = 250 kJ/m2K x floor area (SAP "medium"; SAP 2012 Table 1f indicative TMP: low 100, medium 250,
     high 450 kJ/m2K; RdSAP uses 250). tau = C / HTC.

Few et al. (2023) band deflation is NOT applied: Canet gives no EPC band per LSOA, and the per-town gas
factor already removes the mean EPC bias. Downloaded files are data only; nothing in them is executed.

sources.title: Spatio-temporal heat demand for LSOAs in England and Wales (Annual_heat_demand_LSOA.csv)
sources.publisher: Canet, Cardiff University / UKERC Energy Data Centre (CEDA archive)
sources.version: version 2, 14 Oct 2021 (folder 'version_0' holds the latest per README_FIRST.txt)

sources.title: LSOA (Dec 2011) population weighted centroids in England and Wales
Domestic gas by MSOA / Scottish IZ, 2010-2024 (already fetched by gb_national_scale.py)
ONS MSOA Dec 2021 PWC; Scottish Government IZ 2022 centroids (already fetched)
ERA5 hourly 2 m temperature via Open-Meteo

caveats: Per-meter bias corrected: gas per gas-heated home = gas per meter / h, h = 0.86 (midpoint of census 2021 E&W 0.813 mains-gas-only and 0.913 incl. multi-fuel homes per DESNZ meter); per_meter (h = 1) kept as the uncorrected sensitivity. Scotland: E&W ratio applied (no Scottish census ratio used).
Cooking gas is ignored; hot water is fixed at the model's own mean (5 kWh/day useful).
Within-cell spread is floor-area driven only (NEED band means); occupant behaviour is not in the HTC, so the within-town HTC spread is a lower bound.
Floor-area bands are uniform within band; band 1 taken as 30-50 m2 and band 5 as 201-300 m2.
Canet is gas-boiler dwellings only here; oil/electric/biomass homes are counted toward the 5,000 dwelling radius rule but are not in the records.
Scottish towns: NEED North East form mix, floor area and band ratios (Scotland is not in NEED or Canet), scaled to Intermediate Zone metered gas. scottish_proxy = true.
Few et al. (2023) band deflation not applied: no EPC band in Canet; the gas factor removes the mean bias.
1 DESNZ gas areas had no centroid (unallocated / old codes) and are not used.

epc_check.method:
Independent EPC-register check of the v3 stock (gb_v3_stock.py) for the English and Welsh towns.

For each town: draw LSOAs from the town's v3 LSOA set weighted by Canet dwelling count, take each LSOA's
population-weighted centroid, find the nearest postcode (postcodes.io bulk reverse geocode, OGL/ONSPD data),
list that postcode's certificates (EPC API /api/domestic/search?postcode=), keep the latest per UPRN, and fetch
up to CERTS_PER_PC certificates (/api/certificate) until CAP certificates for the town. From each: dwelling form
(property_type + built_form), total floor area, main heating (mains gas or not) and the RdSAP space-heat demand
(renewable_heat_incentive.space_heating_existing_dwelling, kWh/yr). EPC HTC = that demand / the town's
1991-2020 degree-hours (same basis as the Canet HTC before calibration); "calibrated" multiplies by the town's
gas factor. Results go into stock_v3_meta.json under "epc_check". Extracted fields only are cached (no address,
no UPRN) in data/model/gb/sources/epc_check/<town>.jsonl so a rerun resumes.

API notes (probed 7 Nov 2026): search needs a FULL postcode (sector / district -> 400) or a date range
(date_start, date_end; page, page_size up to 5000, pagination block in the reply). local_authority and council
filters are ignored or rejected. No OpenAPI document at /api/docs or /openapi.json.
Key: state/epc.key, sent only as a Bearer header; never printed. <= 2 EPC requests/s.

sources.title: EPC register API (domestic), MHCLG
sources.licence: OGL v3 (EPC open data terms; address data restricted - none stored)

sources.title: postcodes.io bulk reverse geocode (ONS Postcode Directory)

caveats: Certificates are the latest per UPRN at sampled postcodes: the register over-represents sold and rented homes and recent certificates (newer SAP versions), not the whole stock.
EPC space heat is RdSAP's standard-occupancy figure; raw HTC is on the same basis as Canet's before the gas factor, so 'calibrated' applies the town's v3 gas factor.
Postcodes come from dwelling-weighted LSOA centroids, so a few postcodes per LSOA dominate.

model_calibration.method:
Calibrate the v3 real stock IN THE MODEL'S OWN TERMS (7 Nov 2026, after Craig's check "is our maths correct? the
price cap is only ~1,800 for both fuels"): the first v3 run used ~13% more gas than DESNZ metered gas, because the
stock was calibrated with degree-hours at a 15.5 C base while the model computes demand from each home's set point
and internal gains (an implicit base nearer 17-18 C). See gb_v3_calibrate.py.
